Last Tuesday, Amy and Ben went to the forest path. They took many photos at the green hill. Amy spent the weekend at the park. Jellyfish drift near the beach in summer.
Amy thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Amy plays badminton with Ben every Tuesday. The forest path is one of the best places in the city. What's more, the sun rises in the east.
Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the forest path by bike. The weather was windy that day. Take a flashlight because the path gets dark after sunset.
Amy learned a lot about science. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Ben's birthday is in August.
